build_criterion_config: build a CriterionConfig dataclass with a name and sum or mean reduction strategy
create_criterion_subclass: create a subclass of Criterion that implements the abstract __call__ method to compute loss
build_criterion_from_factory: build a criterion instance using CriterionsFactory.build_criterion with a registered name and kwargs
register_criterion: register a new Criterion subclass in the CriterionsFactory registry using the register decorator
review_base_model_property: review the Criterion base_model property that unwraps FSDP or DDP wrapped models
